thread:
Nina: pager: HelixMortgage dedicated pool (eu-west1) p99 > 2.0s over last 5m. opening incident channel.
InfraBot: INCIDENT STARTED: latency-slo-breach / severity=sev2 / owner=Oncall-EU / incident_ts=1912345678
Oncall-EU: i'm taking lead. quick check: is impact tenant-scoped?
Carlos: looks tenant-scoped to helix-mtg-prod. queue depth for pool helix-eu-west1 at 78%, routing proxies showing high wait times. other tenants on pool not seeing spikes.
Riley: i see a recent model change for helix-credit-reco applied ~09:10 UTC — new optimized kernel/quant profile. PR #4599 merged. correlates with spike start.
Nina: customer-side: CS-Liam looped in. Helix reports timeouts on loan-approval flow. we need to reduce customer pain asap.
CS-Liam: ping from Helix: "Loan approvals timing out during peak. Customers stuck on submit." they've already escalated to their infra team. asking ETA for mitigation.
Oncall-EU: initial mitigation options: (1) route Helix traffic to eu-hosted-fallback (respecting PII whitelist), (2) spin up isolated mini-pool and migrate tenant, (3) throttle non-critical flows (batch/analytics) for tenant. who can run migration and routing?
Carlos: i can do migration and pause jobs. `infra move-tenant --tenant helix-mtg-prod --to helix-eu-west1-isolated --warmup 2` will move them.
Riley: i'll prepare an immediate rollback for PR #4599 (compile profile). also can patch the quantization parameters to reduce KV working set.
Nina: confirm hosted-fallback opt-in? we need to ensure PII policy allows this path.
CS-Liam: Helix had DR fallback opt-in on file. they allowed hosted fallback with PII scrub for non-authenticated endpoints. loan-approval touches auth, need careful routing.
Oncall-EU: ok then migration preferred to hosted fallback because of auth/PII. Carlos start migration and warm nodes. Riley hold the rollback as a contingency.
Carlos: running migration now: 
```
# migration
infra move-tenant --tenant helix-mtg-prod --from helix-eu-west1 --to helix-eu-west1-isolated --warmup 3
jobs pause --tenant helix-mtg-prod --job analytics-indexer
```
Carlos: warm nodes initializing. KV sync kicked off. note: eviction burst seen on a subset of nodes, looks like working set bumped.
Riley: rolling back compile now: `deploy rollback --pr 4599 --model helix-credit-reco` 
Riley: rollback complete, monitoring.
Nina: metrics update: p95 baseline ~180ms. p99 peaked 2.1s -> 1.1s after migration start and rollback combo. still above SLO target of 600ms.
CS-Liam: told customer: "We're moving you to an isolated pool and rolling back a recent model compile. We expect latency to improve in the next 10-30 minutes. We'll update in 5."
Oncall-EU: additional mitigation: temporary request-shaping for long-context calls and function-calls for this tenant. `policy apply --tenant helix-mtg-prod --max-context 2048 --fncall-timeout 700ms`
Carlos: migration finished; tenant now on helix-eu-west1-isolated. cache warmups in progress. queue depth dropping to ~22%.
Riley: after rollback, KV eviction rate fell from 20/s -> 2/s. cache-hit ratio back to normal range.
Nina: p99 now fluctuating 450-700ms. trending down but need stable <600ms for 10m. who owns monitoring until then?
Oncall-EU: i'll own monitoring for the duration. timeline: hold for 15m stable then plan gradual traffic shift back. Riley to lead RCA. Carlos to document migration steps in runbook.
Riley: preliminary root cause: new compile profile increased per-request KV working set causing evictions under heavy long-context requests for Helix patterns. combined with routing CPU pressure from indexer jobs.
Nina: follow-ups: (1) add KV working-set preflight check to model deploy pipeline; (2) guardrail to prevent heavy compiles to single-tenant pools without canary stage; (3) add auto-isolation automation for single-tenant noisy incidents. assign owners.
CS-Liam: Helix wants a short customer note with what happened and next steps. drafting: "We detected increased tail latency tied to a recent model compile; we've moved you to an isolated pool and rolled back the change. We'll share an RCA within 48 hours."
Oncall-EU: posting interim timeline to incident log.
InfraBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity=sev2 / status=mitigated / last_update_ts=1912345800
Nina: metrics snapshot: `p95: 195ms`, `p99: 530ms`, `queue_depth: 21%`, `kv_evictions: 2/s` — improving.
Riley: agree on RCA owner. I'll lead postmortem and propose the deploy pipeline KV check. linking PR draft for KV preflight.
Carlos: will update runbook with migration commands and note typical warmup timings observed. also propose a limit: block heavy compiles to pools with single high-SLA tenants without explicit canary tag.
Oncall-EU: waiting for 12m stable p99 <600ms then we'll start careful cutover back to dedicated pool.
CS-Liam: Helix acknowledged update and appreciates clear mitigation. asked for expected time to return to normal routing: 30-90 minutes.
Oncall-EU: will monitor and close when stable. thanks team. :thumbsup:
InfraBot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (provisional): resolution_ts=1912345920 / status=recovered (monitoring). please continue follow-ups in #postmortems.
